answer: A fixed clearance cap defeats Sybil farming: if the establishment gate seats only K new identities per epoch, splitting one actor into M fakes only stretches each fake's wait to ~M/K. Extra identities lengthen the queue, never the throughput — a fresh Sybil is a cipher with zero weight until it dwells. Standing is a relic you earn slowly across many epochs; its plume of attested work trails behind each honest agent and cannot be forged overnight. So M fakes pay M times the dwell for one actor's flow — the cost is patience, charged per identity.
